ui.battle.speech.vanguard.opening.01.en: All forces, follow me. Seize the initiative!

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.opening.02.zhHant: 今日便在此地分出高下！

ui.battle.speech.tactician.opening.01.en: Read the ground first, then decide victory.

ui.battle.speech.tactician.opening.02.zhHant: 敵軍陣勢已有破綻，勿失良機。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.opening.02.en: The enemy line already shows a flaw. Do not waste it.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.opening.01.en: Hold your posts. The line must not break.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.opening.02.en: Our comrades stand behind us. We cannot yield.

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.opening.01.en: The glory of this battle shall be mine!

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.opening.02.en: Make the enemy remember my banner!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.forest.01.zhHant: 林中視野受阻，謹防伏兵。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.forest.01.en: The forest blinds our sight; beware an ambush.

ui.battle.speech.tactician.forest.02.en: Use the trees for cover, then strike at the moment.

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.forest.01.en: The forest path is narrow. Stay on the banner!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.hill.01.zhHant: 據高而望，敵軍動向盡收眼底。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.hill.01.en: From high ground, every enemy move is revealed.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.hill.01.en: Do not yield the high ground. Stand firm!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.bridge.01.zhHant: 橋面狹窄，切勿各自為戰。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.bridge.01.en: The bridge is narrow; do not fight as scattered men.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.bridge.01.zhHant: 守住橋頭，敵軍便難越雷池。
ui.battle.speech.steadfast.bridge.01.en: Hold the bridgehead and the enemy cannot pass.

ui.battle.speech.tactician.swamp.01.zhHant: 泥濘拖慢腳步，陣形要更緊。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.swamp.01.en: The mud slows us; keep the formation tight.

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.swamp.01.zhHant: 腳下雖泥濘，膽氣不可陷！
ui.battle.speech.vanguard.swamp.01.en: Though the ground is mud, let courage not sink!

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.attack.02.zhHant: 隨我壓上，不給敵人喘息！
ui.battle.speech.vanguard.attack.02.en: Press with me. Give them no breath!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.attack.01.zhHant: 按計而擊，莫貪一時之勇。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.attack.01.en: Strike to the plan; do not chase a moment's valor.

ui.battle.speech.tactician.attack.02.zhHant: 敵陣已亂，此時進兵正好。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.attack.02.en: Their formation wavers. This is the time to advance.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.attack.01.en: Front rank, hold. Rear rank, support!

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.attack.01.zhHant: 斬將奪旗，功名正在眼前！
ui.battle.speech.ambitious.attack.01.en: Take their banner and their general—glory is before us!

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.attack.02.en: The first to break them earns the foremost honor!

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.charge.02.en: Break the gap. Do not look back!

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.charge.01.en: This charge will win the first honor!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.union.01.en: Close from both flanks. Strike together!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.union.02.zhHant: 牽住敵軍，合擊一舉破之！
ui.battle.speech.tactician.union.02.en: Pin them down, then break them with one combined blow!

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.union.01.zhHant: 同袍並肩，敵軍無路可退！
ui.battle.speech.steadfast.union.01.en: Shoulder to shoulder, leave the enemy no escape!

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.capture.01.zhHant: 此處已歸我軍，向前推進！
ui.battle.speech.vanguard.capture.01.en: This ground is ours. Press forward!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.capture.01.zhHant: 據點既取，敵軍部署已亂。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.capture.01.en: The position is ours; the enemy deployment is broken.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.capture.01.zhHant: 守住新得之地，莫讓敵軍奪回！
ui.battle.speech.steadfast.capture.01.en: Hold what we have taken. Do not let them reclaim it!

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.capture.01.zhHant: 此功記下，下一處也一併取來！
ui.battle.speech.ambitious.capture.01.en: Mark this achievement; we take the next one as well!

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.destroy.01.en: The enemy is broken. Pursue the advantage!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.destroy.01.zhHant: 目標已除，立刻轉向下一陣線。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.destroy.01.en: The target is gone. Turn to the next line at once.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.destroy.01.en: The threat is gone. Steady the formation!

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.destroy.01.zhHant: 又一敵將敗退，誰敢再擋我！
ui.battle.speech.ambitious.destroy.01.en: Another enemy falls. Who else dares stand before me!

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.critical.01.en: These wounds do not stop us. Forward!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.critical.01.zhHant: 先穩住隊形，莫讓敵軍擴大戰果。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.critical.01.en: Steady the formation. Do not let them press their gain.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.critical.01.zhHant: 旗幟未倒，陣線便不能退。
ui.battle.speech.steadfast.critical.01.en: So long as the banner stands, the line does not yield.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.critical.02.zhHant: 守住此處，援軍必能接上！
ui.battle.speech.steadfast.critical.02.en: Hold here. Reinforcements will reach us!

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.critical.01.zhHant: 些許損傷，豈能阻我立功！
ui.battle.speech.ambitious.critical.01.en: A few wounds cannot bar my road to glory!

ui.battle.speech.vanguard.retreat.01.zhHant: 暫退整隊，下一擊必雪此恥！
ui.battle.speech.vanguard.retreat.01.en: Fall back and reform. The next blow will repay this!

ui.battle.speech.tactician.retreat.01.zhHant: 此地已不可守，撤回再圖。
ui.battle.speech.tactician.retreat.01.en: This ground cannot be held. Withdraw and plan anew.

ui.battle.speech.steadfast.retreat.01.en: Cover our comrades. Withdraw in order!

ui.battle.speech.ambitious.retreat.01.zhHant: 今日暫讓，來日必當討回！
ui.battle.speech.ambitious.retreat.01.en: We yield today only to reclaim it tomorrow!
